summary: Enhance your hiring process with our Candidate Experience and Employer Reputation Training Course. Build a positive brand and attract top talent today.
lede: Candidate experience is shaped by the interactions people have with an organization throughout the hiring process. For HR leaders, talent acquisition teams, and hiring managers, this course offers practical ways to map candidate journeys, identify bottlenecks, improve recruitment communications, and use candidate feedback to refine hiring touchpoints and employer reputation.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who shape talent journeys, ensuring that every step aligns with organizational values and employment branding strategies.
audience: HR leaders and talent acquisition teams
modules: Candidate Journey Mapping and Experience Design
Communication Excellence Across the Hiring Cycle
Employer Brand Touchpoints and Reputation Signals
Building Fair, Transparent, and Inclusive Hiring Systems
Digital & Social Influence: Career Pages, LinkedIn, Glassdoor
Reducing Bottlenecks, Ghosting, and Drop-off Rates
Candidate Feedback, Data, and Experience Metrics
Crisis and Reputation Risk Management in Recruitment
Creating a Sustainable Candidate Experience Playbook
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of HR practices and recruitment processes. Prior experience in talent acquisition or employer branding is beneficial.
